title: The Smile of Old Chapel Road
author: Ulyana Marchetti
blurb: August Villalobos, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
